notes.title: Today, March 27, we’re launching Your House
notes.content:
[h3]And no, it wasn’t easy.[/h3]

Not because of a lack of ideas, but because of everything else: the details no one notices but keep you up at night, the back-and-forth on things we thought were done, the countless times we said “it’s ready”... and started over.

But now it is.

[b]Your House is finally available.[/b]

It’s a story. One you can play, yes, but also read, listen to, and reflect on. A story about identity, motherhood, and the high cost of chasing your dreams.

Today we’re releasing it into the world with a bit of fear—like always when you share something deeply personal—but also with the enormous joy of having finished something we truly believed in from the start.

We put our minds into it. And our hearts, of course. But more than anything, we put in the will to tell a story that might stay with you.

If it moves you—even just a little— share it with someone. That small gesture helps us more than you know.

[b]Thank you for being there.[/b] And thank you, most of all, for still believing in stories.



Bea & Dani

notes.title: Updated Demo, MacOS Release & French Localization!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

You've been asking, and we've been listening! We’re excited to bring you a new updated demo of YOUR HOUSE, featuring new improvements, bug fixes, and even more immersive storytelling.

But that’s not all – we’re also launching a [b]MacOS version[/b] so even more players can step inside the house where secrets live. And for our French-speaking community, YOUR HOUSE is [b]now available in French[/b]!

[h3]What’s new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New updated demo[/b] – refined and polished for a better experience.
[*] [b]MacOS version available[/b] – now you can play on your preferred platform!
[*] [b]French localization[/b] – fully translated so you can enjoy the mystery in French.
[*] [b]Optimized font sizes [/b]– for better readability and comfort.
[*] [b]Bug fixes [/b]– smoother gameplay, better performance, and an overall enhanced experience.
[/list]
We’re also performing the final checks before launch and are incredibly excited that soon, players will be able to experience the full game!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309260/YOUR_HOUSE_Demo/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729717/10f6bf11725a6aa47d93a3177f8d8a7b6a4153bb.gif[/img][/url]

For those new to YOUR HOUSE, this is a story-driven puzzle game that blends text, exploration, and noir aesthetics. You play as Debbie, a troubled teen who receives a mysterious key to a house full of secrets. The walls, the rooms, the very structure of the house hold the truth about her past—and maybe even her future.

[b]Download the demo now[/b] and let us know what you think! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue shaping YOUR HOUSE into the best experience possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309260/YOUR_HOUSE_Demo/

Thanks for being part of this journey, and as always, [b]home is where the secrets are.[/b]

notes.title: A New Demo for YOUR HOUSE is Here
notes.content:
[h3]Hey [i]armchair[/i] detectives,[/h3]

We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and we’re thrilled to finally invite you to step inside [b]YOUR HOUSE[/b] with [b]a brand-new demo, available now for Steam Next Fest!
[/b]
If you’ve been curious about this [b]narrative puzzle-thriller[/b], now’s your chance to experience the first chapter for free. Immerse yourself in a world where every detail matters, every puzzle hides a secret, and every choice pulls you deeper into the mystery.

[h3]What’s in the Demo?[/h3]

[*] [b]The First Chapter [/b]– Meet Debbie, a rebellious teenager whose life takes a dark turn when she receives a cryptic postcard and an old key.
[*] [b]A Living Puzzle[/b] – Explore an enigmatic house full of hidden doors, secret rooms, and underground passages. Solve escape-room-style challenges woven seamlessly into the narrative.
[*] [b]A Story-Driven Experience[/b] – Unravel the origins of Debbie Steinbecker, the notorious founder of the Killer Kittens, in this prequel to unmemory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729717/10f6bf11725a6aa47d93a3177f8d8a7b6a4153bb.gif[/img]

[h3]Try It, Share Your Thoughts, Help Shape the Game![/h3]

We believe in the power of community feedback, and this demo is your chance to be part of the creative process. Your thoughts will help us refine and polish YOUR HOUSE to make it the best experience possible.

[b]Play the demo now[/b] and let us know what you think! Whether it’s the puzzles, the story, or the game’s unique noir-comic aesthetic, we’d love to hear your impressions.

If you enjoy it, [b]don’t forget to wishlist the game[/b]—it helps us more than you know!

notes.title: New YOUR HOUSE Demo Release
notes.content:
[h3]We are releasing a NEW demo for YOUR HOUSE on Steam! [/h3]

After months of hard work and dedication, our team at Patrones & Escondites is excited to invite you to step into the mystery world we've created, where every corner hides secrets.

[b]YOUR HOUSE[/b] is set in the same universe as our first game, [b]UNMEMORY[/b], serving as a prequel that explores the origins of Debbie Steinbecker, the notorious founder of the Killer Kittens.
The demo features the first chapter of a compelling five-chapter narrative. You’ll get to experience haunting environments, interact with intriguing characters, and solve puzzles that will challenge your intellect and immerse you in the story.

As you navigate through the demo, you’ll be introduced to the aesthetic and emotional depth that characterize the game. We’ve put a lot of love into making sure that every detail matters, from the subtle sound design to the intricacies of the storytelling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729717/010eca7720a138109159b43a9486953d56006530.gif[/img]

[h3]Try it now and share your feedback![/h3]

We believe in the power of feedback, and releasing this demo is our way of inviting you into our creative process. Your insights will help us refine and enhance the game, ensuring that the final product meets your expectations. Whether it's gameplay mechanics, narrative elements, or visual presentation, we are eager to hear your thoughts.

We encourage you to play the demo, share your thoughts, and engage with us as we continue this journey. Your feedback is invaluable and will help shape the final version of [b]YOUR HOUSE[/b].
The demo is now live on Steam, so don’t miss your chance to uncover the mysteries within! Download it today, and let us know what you think! And if you enjoy it, consider adding it to your wishlist.

To get a sneak peek of what’s in store, be sure to check out our trailer. Thank you for being a part of our adventure, and happy exploring!
